conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: On one side of the staircase, the cherry blossoms, severed from time, still reflect the scene of that moment. When Lina's scream collided with Youmu's blade, the air of the Netherworld froze. The visible soundwave exploded into emerald-colored ripples before the tachi. Youmu's slash stalled for the first time—not blocked, but as if sinking into thick resin, every inch of progress tearing through countless layers of sonic booms. The stone steps beneath Lina's feet cracked, and countless green bamboo shoots burst from the ground. These jade-like bamboos grew into natural lattices along the sword's trajectory, the bamboo joints clashing with the blade producing chime-like clear sounds. The girl's skin rapidly turned woody, and the tender shoots sprouting from her hair swayed violently in the soundwave. When the deadliest sword gleam finally pierced through all obstacles, those bamboo branches suddenly bloomed with white flowers collectively, the petals wrapping around the sharp edge of the blade's tip. Youmu's sword stopped at Lina's brow, and Lina's scream also ceased abruptly. As she staggered back, the bark peeled off her body into specks of light, and the severed bamboo branches turned into Spring Energy fireflies. The girl's figure became much more transparent. Under that strike, Youmu only slowly sheathed her sword from behind, failing to pierce the brow. Behind Lina, Youmu still maintained her sword-sheathing posture.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Oww! Bully!!" #Lina, in pain, lay on the ground holding her head and crying.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Her momentum surged with each step after that strike. The Gardener's Aura: Youmu's attacks gain additional dice equal to the cumulative damage dealt. Her pupils reflected Long'er's figure.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er stands ready.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl uttered a whisper only she could hear. "Human God Sword... Night Attendant Reflecting Satellite Slash"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #First, choose to defend.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Youmu's action of sheathing her sword carried a ritual-like solemnity. The light sound of the tsuba meeting the scabbard actually sent ripples through the Netherworld. The pure white steps beneath her feet began to show crack-like patterns—not shattering, but more like awakening veins, with dark red light flowing within— She did not draw immediately but maintained a bowing, sword-pressing posture, as if listening to the heartbeat from within the scabbard. When the spiritual power swirling around Long'er reached its peak, Youmu moved—the trajectory of the tachi's draw was startlingly simple. No dazzling light effects, no air-rending shrieks, only a silver line as thin as early snow slowly appearing in the air. Yet the moment this silver line was born, the entire space began to fold. The vast spiritual power Long'er unleashed collided with an invisible prism, being refracted and deflected entirely, turning into countless fragmented streams of light swirling around the silver line. And far more than that—the scattered Spring Energy, the flickering Netherworld flames, even the debris from the steps beneath everyone's feet, all condensed and reformed around this silver line, turning into countless semi-transparent虚无之剑. As if responding to the girl's words.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Mr. Tenjouin!" #Seeing such a perilous situation, she anxiously shouted out.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The虚无之剑 began to move following some profound trajectory, like satellites orbiting a planet, trapping Long'er at the center. Each虚无之剑 reflected the initial silver line Youmu had slashed. Each reflection made the silver line's trajectory more complex, more lethal. The sword technique had already formed its own world, and Long'er became the sole target within this world. When the myriad reflected silver lines finally intertwined into an inescapable net of certain death, Youmu's figure seemed to transform into a star within this sword-technique starscape. Where the blade passed, there was no earth-shattering roar, only a subtle sound like cutting paper—the sound of space itself being severed. The Netherworld wind suddenly grew heavy, as if even time chose to submit before this slash. In the entire space, only the girl's initial words echoed: Night Attendant Reflecting Satellite Slash.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er's Messiah Fist surged and spread over his body like liquid. The sturdy armor made of Orichalcum emitting a pale green light resisted the interweaving silver lines. Some sword gleams, before landing on him, flew back in the direction they came from as if time had reversed. He activated his ability to its fullest, his face even turning into the pale complexion of a zombie.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: At Long'er's home, someone is still waiting for him to return. When the dense barrage of sword glints finally dissipates, Tenjoin props himself up, his body covered in wounds.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Your sword, your will... truly strong."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "A respectable opponent." The girl forcing herself to stand says this.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I promised that guy I wouldn't die."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "I see..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Even so, must we still fight on?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl closes her eyes and lets out a sigh.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Fighting hurts. I don't like it."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "I also promised Lady Yuyuko I would protect the safety of Hakugyokurou, even though I'm still quite incompetent." The girl looks at the tachi in her hand.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "It really hurts, you know. So this is how Mokou feels every time she fights with the Princess?" #Long'er breathes heavily with effort, propping himself up to avoid collapsing directly to the ground.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Combat is something that brings pain and death..." "For the sake of one spring, is it worth it?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Impressive. Truly a battle-hardened body."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Of course it's worth it."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "All things in the world follow their own natural order."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "It's worth it! This is the spring that makes the flowers bloom!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "With this spring, I can endure a few more times. Without this spring, I might not be able to endure at all."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "This is really..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "To properly enjoy each day in the future, I must take it back."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl sighed, the sharp aura around her beginning to recede. "I'm defeated, defeated..."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "If spring doesn't come, I won't be able to have the spring bamboo shoot hotpot I promised Mokou."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Although it's very frustrating, I also hope Lady Yuyuko will return spring." "Since you have such determination..." The girl stepped aside. "I respect your will."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Huh? That's great!" #rushes over to hug Youmu and rubs cheeks.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "It's all your fault for ambushing me at the start, I forgot to ask you. Have you seen a very suspicious-looking blonde woman?" #Long'er asks Youmu.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Lady Yuyuko is just a bit willful, she's a very good person, but to strangers... ahh."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Ge Qing had somehow already arrived behind Youmu and lightly tapped the back of her neck. Just as Youmu was puzzled, she first felt a sharp pain in her shoulder, which gradually spread throughout her body, followed by a tingling numbness and dizziness...

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #pulls Lina's face away.

conversation.speaker: player3

conversation.speaker: player1

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #folds the Saw Cleaver and puts it behind his back, then bows deeply to the girl. "Thank you very much. We will live up to your expectations."

conversation.speaker: player1

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Huh? But she's a good person too, right? Isn't it okay to want to get close to a good person?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Youmu's face is still red.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Hey, I'm asking you a question, have you seen her or not?" #takes out some Golden Wound Medicine from his pocket and applies it to himself.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Blonde woman..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "At first, I was worried that your half-human, half-phantom constitution might be different from ordinary people. It seems I was overthinking it. Rest well."

conversation.speaker: player1
